description: Executes a tool by name with the given arguments. Use it for tools that are not directly listed — look them up with find_tools and check their arguments with tool_schema first. Prefer a directly-listed tool whenever one fits. If the action is destructive, ask the user to confirm before calling it.

arguments.description: Arguments object matching the tool's schema.

name.description: Exact tool name, as returned by find_tools.

name: run_tool
title: Run a tool
